question: Related Questions Q. I would like to ask you regarding the permissibility of children (na-baligh) standing in the rows of adults in the masjid. In our masjid (in London, UK), 2 groups seem to have developed. 1 group says it is necessary for the children to stand in the rows at the back of the congregation during salaat, whereas the other says children should/can stand within the adult rows. Both groups quote different ulama to support their views. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 8953 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: 1) Can I pray Umr Qada when travelling along with Qasr. For eg. I pray Two Raka'as Dhuhr Qasr and then Four Raka'as Dhuhr Umr Qadha. Question: 1) Can I pray Umr Qada when travelling along with Qasr. For eg. I pray Two Raka'as Dhuhr Qasr and then Four Raka'as Dhuhr Umr Qadha. Answer ID: 8953 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2024/1874=D/1429) Yes, you can pray. If you are musafir and pray the timely salah with qasr , if you like to make qaza of the salah missed during your stay at home then you can make up them by offering full (4 rakah). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
